codeReview.summary: Solid implementation of the controls UI feature. The ControlsManager state machine is well-structured with clear lifecycle states (loading→ready→running→error) and correct button enable/disable rules. Double-click prevention on Start, confirmation dialogs for Reboot and Wipe, DebugLogger with HTML escaping and auto-scroll, and Fullscreen API integration with exit button are all correctly implemented. Tests cover all 29 cases including state transitions, callbacks, and log formatting. The main.ts refactor cleanly integrates the ControlsManager with the existing emulator loader. A few non-blocking issues: a misleading test name, an unused exported utility function, and silent catch blocks in fullscreen handlers.

issues.description: Test name 'disables all action buttons except Fullscreen in error state' is misleading. The test does NOT assert Fullscreen button state, yet the actual code disables Fullscreen in error state too (btnFullscreen.disabled = true). The test name implies Fullscreen stays enabled, but it's simply not checked. Should either rename to 'disables all action buttons in error state' or add an assertion for btnFullscreen.

formatLogEntry() is exported and tested but never used at runtime. DebugLogger.log() contains duplicate formatting logic (building the same HTML structure independently). This creates maintenance risk — if the format changes, both must be updated. Consider having DebugLogger.log() call formatLogEntry() internally, or remove the standalone function.

Silent catch blocks in handleFullscreenClick() and handleExitFullscreenClick() swallow errors with empty arrow functions: `.catch(() => {})`. AGENTS.md convention states 'Always handle errors explicitly. Never swallow errors silently.' While these are expected-path failures (fullscreen not supported, user denied), they should at minimum log to console or the debug logger.

Console interception only captures messages prefixed with '[QEMU]'. The feature description says 'Capture Emscripten stderr/stdout output' but Emscripten's default print/printErr may not use this prefix. Also console.error is not intercepted (Emscripten printErr can map to console.error). This means some Emscripten output may not reach the debug panel. Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker followed TDD procedure correctly (wrote tests first, ran red, implemented green). The only deviation was using curl-based verification instead of agent-browser due to missing Playwright system deps — this is a known documented limitation. The skill's step 5 should perhaps explicitly mention curl fallback as the standard approach when browser deps are unavailable.

summary: Feature controls-ui passes review. The implementation correctly covers all required functionality: Start button state machine with double-click prevention, Reboot with confirmation dialog, Debug log panel with timestamped HTML-escaped entries, and Fullscreen with exit button. 29 Vitest tests cover all state transitions and edge cases. The main.ts refactor cleanly integrates ControlsManager and DebugLogger. Four non-blocking issues identified: a misleading test name (says 'except Fullscreen' but doesn't test it), an unused but tested formatLogEntry utility (duplicated by DebugLogger.log), silent catch blocks in fullscreen handlers, and selective console interception. None of these affect correctness or user-facing behavior.
